about:
True Precision Plastics operates as a division of ResTech Plastics, LLC, from its facility in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. The company's history and founding year are not disclosed in available records, nor are details about its ownership structure or founders.

The company specializes in custom injection molding, including thick- and thin-wall molding, and complements its molding operations with in-house assembly, CNC machining, coating services such as chrome plating, and vibration welding—a capability it notes is available from only two processors on the East Coast. Value-added services are performed either internally or through approved suppliers. Its injection molding machines handle a range of part sizes and complexities, and the firm emphasizes its ability to provide turnkey solutions from molding through finishing.

Specific industries served are not listed in the provided data. The company's capabilities suggest it serves customers requiring precision molded components with secondary operations, but no concrete customer types or sector examples are given.

The company highlights its vibration welding capability as a key differentiator, stating it is one of only two processors on the East Coast offering the process. It also promotes its in-house value-added services as a way to streamline supply chains for clients.
